description: P3 consumer-assertion: CHECK 17 in tools/policy_check.sh is the guard that keeps plugin/skills/_shared/brood-state.sh the only code that reads coordinator brood state (the brood listing, a brood manifest, a child run ledger, a child's facts evidence and the pre-launch facts guard), per the Trust-Boundary Discipline section of plugin/governance/security-policy.md: a reader takes identifiers and derives every location itself, never a path. This fixture pins ten literals in tools/policy_check.sh, so deleting or hollowing the check is loud: the `=== CHECK 17:` banner (the check runs and announces itself); the three token-list assignments CHECK17_SHARED_TOKENS (.hivemind/broods and manifest.json, flagged in every skill script), CHECK17_FACTS_TOKEN (.hivemind/facts, flagged everywhere except the facts producer) and CHECK17_BROOD_SCOPE_TOKENS (.hivemind/runs and state.json, flagged in brood-scope scripts), each exactly as written, so dropping a token from a list turns this fixture red; the reader-file assignment `CHECK17_READER_FILE='plugin/skills/_shared/brood-state.sh'` and the loop test `if [[ "$check17_rel" == "$CHECK17_READER_FILE" ]]; then` that skips it (the reader-file exemption names exactly that one file); the classifier test `if [[ "$line_body" =~ ^[^#]*($token_regex) ]]; then` (a token counts only before any `#`, the CHECK 9 convention for an executable line); the per-script call `check17_scan_script "$check17_script"` (every discovered script still reaches the scan); `add_finding 'CHECK17'` (the check still reports through the shared finding machinery, so --strict applies to it); and the bare call line `check17_run_detection_canary` (the detection canary still runs; its definition line does not match, because the pin requires the name to end the line). superset mode fails if any literal is removed; extras elsewhere in the file are ignored. Behaviour this pin does not itself carry, but which the CHECK 17 detection canary asserts at run time over fixed lines, both directions: a token assignment, jq or cat on a token path, a glob over .hivemind/facts, .hivemind/broods alone, .hivemind/runs alone and state.json in brood scope, a pinned line read outside the pin file, and manifest.json in the facts producer are each flagged; a comment, an indented comment, a reader call, a pinned line, state.json outside brood scope and .hivemind/facts in the facts producer are not; a brood-skill path and a script that sources ledger-project.sh are in brood scope while a commented source line is not; and the pin evaluation reports a missing pin as stale, a duplicated pin as ambiguous (exempting neither copy), and an unreadable pin file as a failure. Residuals, stated plainly: a presence pin proves the literals exist, not that they still run in order or that the canary assertions still hold; a hollowed check that keeps every pinned literal is caught only by the canary and the scan-count finding. The exemption list is closed by review, not by this fixture: a new exemption branch, a new CHECK17_PIN_LINES entry or a wider CHECK17_FACTS_PRODUCER_FILE leaves every pinned literal intact, and every such change is a reviewed diff of tools/policy_check.sh. A copy of a pinned literal added elsewhere in the file, such as a comment quoting it, masks deletion of the original; `add_finding 'CHECK17'` already appears more than once, so it guards only the deletion of every copy. CHECK 17 itself does not see a token assembled from parts or one after a `#` that does not start a comment, judges each physical line alone, and covers only plugin/skills/**/*.sh.

set_check.extract_regex: (===\ CHECK\ 17:\ Coordinator\ brood\-state\ reads\ go\ through\ the\ confined\ reader\ ===|CHECK17_SHARED_TOKENS='\\\.hivemind/broods\|manifest\\\.json'|CHECK17_FACTS_TOKEN='\\\.hivemind/facts'|CHECK17_BROOD_SCOPE_TOKENS='\\\.hivemind/runs\|state\\\.json'|CHECK17_READER_FILE='plugin/skills/_shared/brood\-state\.sh'|if\ \[\[\ "\$check17_rel"\ ==\ "\$CHECK17_READER_FILE"\ \]\];\ then|if\ \[\[\ "\$line_body"\ =\~\ \^\[\^\#\]\*\(\$token_regex\)\ \]\];\ then|check17_scan_script\ "\$check17_script"|add_finding\ 'CHECK17'|(?m:^)check17_run_detection_canary(?=$))
expected_set: === CHECK 17: Coordinator brood-state reads go through the confined reader ===
